topic: Future retirement risk - Melita TransGas (Malta-Italy) pipeline
wiki_text: The Melita TransGas Pipeline (MTGP), a 159km subsea gas pipeline from Delimara (Malta) to Gela (Sicily, Italy), is explicitly designed to eventually replace the need for the Delimara FSU/FSRU and its onshore regasification facility, once operational. As of mid-2026 the project has completed permitting in both Malta (EIA approved 2021) and Italy (Autorizzazione Unica, 2022) and retains EU Project of Common Interest status (PCI 5.19, EUR3.7m TEN-E/CEF co-financing through 2023), but construction has not yet started: indicative construction start is 2028 with commissioning in 2030. No FID has been confirmed in available sources. This means the Delimara FSRU (Armada LNG Mediterrana) is expected to remain in service for at least several more years; no near-term status/vessel change is warranted. Reviewer should watch for an FID announcement or construction start, which would be the trigger for a future ShelvedYear/RetiredYear-style timeline entry on this terminal once the pipeline actually displaces it.
